instruction.text: Decide whether the statement is true or false.

atoms.a: Sex refers to the biological differences between males, females, and other groups.
Gender refers to the biological distinctions between men and women.

wrong.text: Gender is about socially constructed roles and behaviours, not biological differences.

atoms.a: Patriarchy is a social system where men generally hold more privilege than women  and other gender identities.
All societies today have completely eliminated patriarchy.

wrong.text: Many societies still retain patriarchal structures to varying degrees.

atoms.a: The right to vote is one of the main achievements of feminist movements.
Absolute gender equality has already been achieved in modern societies.

wrong.text: Despite progress, modern societies still exhibit a gender gap in many areas.

atoms.a: Women generally earn less than men on average even when performing the same work.
Women are equally represented in leadership positions across most industries.

wrong.text: Women remain underrepresented in professional leadership roles due to barriers like the glass ceiling and old boy networks.

atoms.a: In many religious communities, women are disadvantaged in both leadership roles and assigned private responsibilities.
Media often portrays women in neutral or non-stereotypical roles only.

wrong.text: Media frequently reinforces stereotypes, portraying women as sexual objects or as “damsels in distress”.

atoms.a: Society often assumes that women should be the primary caregivers for children and elderly family members.
Professionally successful women are never criticized for balancing career and family responsibilities.

wrong.text: Even successful women often face societal pressure suggesting their career success comes at the expense of family.

atoms.a: Women without children are sometimes perceived as lacking or incomplete.
Domestic violence disproportionately affects women and girls.
The Succession to the Crown Act 2013 allows both sons and daughters equal rights to inherit the British throne.
The <mat>#</mat>MeToo movement started in 2017 to highlight sexual harassment, mainly in workplaces.
Roe v. Wade, the 1973 Supreme Court decision legalizing abortion, is still valid in all US states.

wrong.text: Roe v. Wade was overturned in 2022, allowing states to pass restrictive abortion laws.

atoms.a: Pro-life and pro-choice movements represent opposing perspectives on abortion.
Gender gaps no longer exist in areas like income, media representation, or religious leadership.

wrong.text: Significant gender gaps persist in many areas, including income, media portrayal, and access to leadership positions.
